title: Jess, who you kept

greeting.text: The bell. Jess, in a ranger-issue blanket, come back up the hill in a borrowed car. She does not come all the way to the counter.
I had to see. They put up the posters at the station today. The missing ones. And I thought: that's who made me the coffee.

annoyed: You looked at Tom like that. Right before.

notes.wrist: Her hands are shaking. Her veins are exactly where they were.
notes.reflection: Her back. And the counter. Count who is behind it.

topics.answer: Because you took that thing off me when you didn't have to. And I can't work out why one of them would.
...You don't know. Oh my God. You actually don't know.
topics.note: Wren is suddenly standing very close to you.

topics.ask: Jess. Go back down. Tell them everything.
topics.answer: I will. Whatever you are: thank you. I mean that.

wren.arrive: You saved her once. That was once.
wren.adviceLine: She's seen the posters. She'll say it out loud in a minute. Get her out of here before she says it, Sam.

serve.text: Take a coffee for the road. Drive slowly.
You're kinder than he was by the end. Is that awful to say?

turnAway.text: I know. I know. I just needed to see your face do it.

shelter.text: ...No. I don't think I will. I've seen what you do with people out the back.

walkout.text: There. That look. That's the one.
